notes.title: Update 2!
notes.content:
We bring you even more improvements!

First, the gameplay:
[list]
[*]3 New achievements!
[*]Most "collectible" achievements now require you to find all the collectibles before saving all three baby kaiju. This makes it more challenging, and much more engaging!
[*]Some changes to the layout of the level, and locations of collectibles!
[*]Swarms in attack mode can now be destroyed by a dash once all three baby kaiju can be saved
[*]Even more bug-fixes.
[/list]

And of course, aesthetically:
[list]
[*]More Lighting Improvements!
[*]Some new textures
[*]You no longer just flip upside down when you die. (I'd tell you what happens, but I don't want to ruin the surprise.)
[*]The level exit has some helpful audio queues.
[/list]

Thank you for playing! We hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Update 1!
notes.content:
This update includes:
[list]
[*]Numerous bugfixes
[*]Various changes to the level layout to help it flow better (and fall apart better!)
[*]Lighting and texturing changes to help with readability
[/list]
There are also some notable gameplay changes!
[list]
[*]The level has an exit at the end, and a time bonus will be added to your score when you leave
[*]You are no longer limited to 30 seconds when you grab the last baby kaiju
[*]Enemies are a bit easier to fight, and display their remaining health
[/list]

Enjoy!
